data.headline: Field CTO - Lenovo Americas Infrastructure Group
data.about:
John is an expert generalist with more than 20+ years of experience across the IT industry. His career in IT started doing desktop support for a hospital during the Y2K years. Since that time, John has worked his way up through the ranks, serving as a systems administrator and server engineer at different companies before becoming a Pre-Sales Engineer and solution architect for Lenovo. At Lenovo, John was the Americas pre-sales platform technical lead, consulting with customers on server architectures, HCI solutions, performance optimization and datacenter strategy. 

John is currently the technical lead and one of the founding directors for Lenovo’s Field C Suite, the business strategy team focused on digital transformation, design thinking and the application of smarter technology. Their work centers on the analysis of future trends, tailored exploration and discovery to help executive leaders look across their business with a new perspective. 

As the strategic thinker and solutions architect for the Field C Suite, John brings an expertise in defining technology strategies, identifying IT processes and tactical projects that enhance IT transformation and challenge a company’s basic assumptions about the future of their business.

subComponents.title: Principal Technical Consultant & Field CTO - ISG North America
subComponents.caption: Jan 2020 - Present · 6 yrs

description.text:
John is CTO for Lenovo’s Field C Suite working with senior leaders to translate business and operational vision into technical solutions. His advisory expertise lies in discovering and augmenting business value through technical innovation and organizational change. John is a senior strategic thinker and solutions architect who brings a keen diagnostics skillset to any conversation. With more than 20 years of experience in the tech space, his particular strengths are in information analysis, strategic design, solutions architecture, technical and sales communication and leadership.

The Lenovo Field C Suite is a strategic sales team whose customer focus is to drive Business Transformation through Technology, helping leaders identify digital innovation strategies across industries and from organizations spanning mid-market enterprises to global corporations.

subComponents.title: Sr. Solution Architect & Team Lead - Advanced Solutions Group - Datacenter Infrastructure
subComponents.caption: Oct 2014 - Jan 2020 · 5 yrs 3 mos

description.text:
Work in an above-country consulting role for field technical sales acting as strategic consultant, solution architect, server / virtualization platform SME and consultant to WW marketing teams. Carry a NA quota and tasked with grow overall datacenter group revenue.
* Senior strategist and technical lead for Field C Suite team
* Datacenter Infrastructure team lead managing a group of five Senior SAs helping drive overall ASG team strategy, managing cross team projects and driving team revenue attainment to influence US $250M in NA revenue
* Technical management lead crafting channel partner growth strategy and field SA roles and responsibilities
* Technical consultant for channel partners and enterprise customers, helping to architect solutions, craft IT strategy, identify and resolve IT process issues, performance optimize systems and gather technical requirements for development
* SME for field technical sellers providing deep technical and solution design skills across server and virtualization platforms portfolio, performance optimization and deployment tools
* Solution architect and evangelist for emerging technologies, cloud, DevOps, database and software defined datacenter
* Lead pre-General Availability (GA) technical launch activities for server platforms - including design feedback to development, customer and test plan validation and ongoing field technical support
* Develop and deliver technical, educational and sales presentations and demonstrations at customer briefings and vendor conferences and for dissemination to field sellers
* Work with WW marketing team to craft client value messages, drive launch activities, provide technical requirements to development, and define standard solution model configurations
* Responsible for architecture and implementation of Customer Innovation Center POC lab; design and day-to-day maintenance of field enablement lab

Advanced Technical Pre-Sales Support
Worked in an above-country role for field sales engineers acting as a subject matter expert across numerous systems and technologies, served as technical seller for larger enterprise financial customers, interfaced with development teams to help drive requirements and worldwide marketing teams to help craft sales messages
* Served as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for field technical sellers providing deep technical skills on 2-socket (2S), 4S & 8S rack systems, converged platforms, new technologies, virtualization, performance and deployment tools
* Led pre-General Availability (GA) technical launch activities for 2S, 4S, 8S and x86 Flex Systems
* Served in technical consultative role architecting solutions, tuning systems and gathering technical requirements for development
* Developed technical documentation for field technical sellers
* Developed and delivered conference sessions on solution sizing, performance tuning, RAID, Proof of Concept (POC) design and implementation and solution design for converged systems
* Worked with worldwide marketing team to craft client value messages, drive launch activities, provide technical requirements to development and define model configurations
* Interfaced with worldwide teams to develop global knowledge sharing across a multitude of technologies for POC implementations, problem determination and system optimization
